hero.description: Computer Science Engineer recently graduated from EPN, with two years of real production experience at Wanqara. I developed active frontend modules with Vue.js and took ownership of the entire E2E suite using Playwright: test architecture, CI pipelines in GitHub Actions, and resolving race conditions between environments. I specialize in building solid interfaces and ensuring they reach production bug-free.

about.title: About me
about.p1: Recently graduated in Computer Science Engineering from EPN, with two years of real-world experience at Wanqara developing production frontend modules and taking responsibility for the team's quality infrastructure: E2E test suite with Playwright, CI pipelines in GitHub Actions, and resolving race conditions across environments.
about.p2: For my thesis, I built an academic assistant with RAG architecture deployed on Linux with Nginx and SSL. I chose RAG over fine-tuning because institutional regulations change frequently, and updating embeddings in Qdrant is trivial compared to retraining a model. The system handled 26,000 concurrent queries with zero failures and 23 ms latency in cache using Redis.
about.p3: I am seeking a junior role where I can continue developing interfaces and contribute to software quality from the very beginning of the lifecycle, not as an afterthought.

contact.description: Available for job opportunities, technical collaborations, or project inquiries. You can reach out to me directly through any of these channels.
